items.title_orig: Tragic irony of big 4/5 song titles
items.article_text:
spoiler tag because the content (death) in the post might be triggering to some
 I noticed that the big 4/5 have song names that are quite tragic and ironic given how each of the frontmen turned out:
 Nirvana: I Hate Myself and Want to Die
 Soundgarden: Pretty Noose
 Alice in Chains: Rain When I Die
 Stone Temple Pilots: Dead and Bloated
 Pearl Jam: Alive
 May they rest in peace 🕯️
